purpose: One local, bounded E4B QLoRA feasibility and translation-quality pilot; no production promotion or claimed accuracy gain before independent review.

model.quantization: bitsandbytes NF4, double quantization, bfloat16 compute
model.baseline: Adapter disabled on the identical loaded HF/NF4 checkpoint. This differs from historical CPU Q4_0 GGUF inference; those results remain a separate comparison.

data.target_size: 128 independent clean training pairs, up to32 real Whisper transcript variants;20 independent validation source groups with clean and Whisper variants if suitable public audio is accessible.
data.rule: Select independently sourced material without evaluation-case content mining. Freeze accepted source/target rows, partitions, provenance and lexical overlap audit before model evaluation or pilot training. No FLEURS data in training. All variants and recordings of the same text stay in one partition. No silent truncation, synthetic ASR presented as real, or unreviewed generated targets.
data.protection: tests/prepare_adapter_data.py checks all70 existing evaluation references internally without printing heldout text or opening heldout audio; this is a lexical contamination guard, not proof against semantic or pretraining overlap.

source.limitations: Native male read speech; train/dev speakers may overlap. Not representative of spontaneous dialogue or anime. Local pilot only; preserve original corpus license/attribution metadata.

data.noisy_training_scope: 28 variants have equivalent meaning/orthographic changes; two contain plausible contextual repairs. Excluded train0573/0369 noise variants because target requires unsupported changed/missing meaning; clean counterparts retained. Not comprehensive noisy-speech specialization.

smoke.source: 妹は昨日、駅で赤い傘を買いました。
smoke.target: My younger sister bought a red umbrella at the station yesterday.
smoke.rule: One independent handcrafted readiness example, separate disposable adapter. Require finite loss, nonzero adapter gradients and weight update, adapter save/reload, unchanged adapter-off outputs. The real pilot starts afresh from base weights.
smoke.subsequent_runner_edits: Only artifact verification, evaluation coverage/error reporting and frozen protocol hash binding; model preparation, assistant mask, optimizer and training loop unchanged from passing smoke.

training.loss: Assistant JSON answer tokens only, using the existing JREAD system/user messages and Gemma4 thinking-disabled template; fail if exact prefix masking cannot be established.
training.checkpoint_selection: Final single-epoch adapter only. No checkpoint cherry-picking or automatic repeated experiments.

evaluation.first_screen: All independently frozen validation groups. Report clean and real-Whisper-input results separately; variants are paired observations, not independent extra cases.
evaluation.meaning_rule: Preserve every major proposition, roles, polarity, entity and number; natural faithful paraphrases pass. Unsupported additions, omissions, missing/error output fail. Record unclear separately and retain it in the denominator.
evaluation.review: Build a condition-blind packet; independent model-assisted reviewer plus root audit. Freeze candidate grades before joining condition labels. This is not native-speaker certification.
evaluation.latency: Measure complete sequential generation and parsing, warmup separate, errors included. Report actual GPU runtime. Do not compare GPU seconds with historical CPU seconds as a training speedup or as browser latency.
evaluation.development_followup: Only after a fresh-validation gain without clean-input regressions, freeze a single candidate and evaluate the unchanged20 development inputs with the unchanged rubric. Never include their references in prompts or training.
evaluation.heldout: Existing50 cases remain unused during pilot selection. A final unseen evaluation is required before production promotion or general accuracy claims.
evaluation.candidate_selection_rule: Primary temperature0 is eligible for old20 development followup only if adapter-on increases noisy-input passes over its matched adapter-off baseline without losing clean-input passes. If primary is ineligible, apply the identical rule to secondary temperature0.6 seed17. Otherwise stop this bounded pilot without development reruns or promotion. Counts are model-assisted against frozen propositions, unclear in denominator.

execution.gpu_jobs: Serialize ASR data preparation and model smoke/training/evaluation; one owned GPU job at a time.
execution.completion: One completion notification per background chain; no polling loop or recurring schedule.
